t: Founded in 973 by Tailapa II, who overthrew the Rashtrakutas and claimed descent from the Chalukyas of Badami.
Its kings ruled from Kalyani and fought the Chola Empire for two centuries over the Raichur doab and Vengi.
Its courts produced the Mitakshara, rich Kannada literature and an ornate temple style that inspired the Hoysalas.
dyk: Someshvara I, stricken by incurable illness in 1068, ended his life by drowning in the Tungabhadra river, a death recorded by the poet Bilhana and in inscriptions.
ev: Tailapa II overthrows the Rashtrakuta king Karka II
Tailapa II defeats and captures the Paramara king Vakpati Munja
Rajendra I Chola defeats Jayasimha II at Maski
The Chola king Rajadhiraja I is killed at the Battle of Koppam
Vikramaditya VI takes the throne and begins the Chalukya-Vikrama era
The Kalachuri Bijjala II takes royal titles at Kalyani
Someshvara IV disappears; Yadavas and Hoysalas divide the empire

f.successor: Seuna Yadava dynasty; Hoysala Empire; Kakatiya dynasty
